text:
HTTP2::version
Description
This command can be used to determine the HTTP/2 protocol version
used. Returns the HTTP/2 protocol version used. Returns 0 if no HTTP/2
request is active.
Syntax
HTTP2
::
version
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
HTTP2
::
version
]
!=
0
}
{
HTTP
::
header
insert
"X-HTTP2-Values version "
"[HTTP2::version]"
}
}
